visual_description: A heavy steel industrial workbench under bright, cool-white LED shop lights. On the table sits the opened specimen crate, a laptop showing the field GPS coordinates, and a set of heavy-duty 'bolt cutters' used to snip the wire mesh inside the plaster jackets. A magnifying lamp is swung over the center of the table.

constraints.material: Brushed stainless steel table top; industrial green painted legs.
constraints.background: A clean, white-walled lab interior with a 'Danger: Silica Dust' warning sign on the wall.
